title: Grok Bot alternative: pi-durable-bot (Pots), open source
description: The open-source Grok Bot alternative: an AI coworker that acts on its own. MIT-licensed, on any machine you choose, with any model, in any channel.
claim: An AI coworker that acts on its own and does the work on its own computer.
answer: pi-durable-bot (Pots) is an open-source AI coworker that decides when to act and works on its own computer. Grok Bot is SpaceXSI's closed service of always-on AI teammates on the maker's cloud. The difference: Pots runs on any machine you choose, with any model, and its code is yours.

rivalIs.text: Grok Bot, from SpaceXSI (formerly xAI), is a team of always-on AI teammates. A user's Bots share one cloud computer, sign in to your tools, and come back to you when they need approval. You use them in desktop and mobile apps and on X; team Bots also work in Slack.

table.note: Grok Bot cells: SpaceXSI's public pages, checked 2026-11-10. Your data: with a local model for the agent and the judge, nothing leaves your machine; with a hosted model, requests go to the provider you chose.

rows.label: Model
rows.pots: Any: your subscription, 40+ providers, or a local model
rows.rival: The maker picks per task; no model picker

rows.label: Where you talk to it
rows.pots: Any channel (Slack, Discord, Telegram, and more)
rows.rival: Desktop and mobile apps, X; Slack for team bots

rows.label: Your data
rows.pots: On your machine, in each bot's folder

rows.label: Change the agent itself
rows.rival: No. Plugins, MCP servers and settings

rows.label: Messages that do not mention it
rows.pots: Yes. It decides if they are its job
rows.rival: Not stated. Slack docs describe mentions

rows.label: Asks before it acts
rows.pots: No. No approval step on its computer
rows.rival: Yes. Auto Review, on by default

rows.label: Price
rows.pots: Free (MIT). You bring the machine and the model
rows.rival: From USD 30 a month; extra use billed by token cost

pickRival: You want a hosted service with nothing to install or run.
You want its desktop and phone apps, and X.
You want to teach it a task by showing it once.
Your company needs admin controls such as DLP and network rules.
pickPots: You want the code, and to change the agent itself.
You want it on a machine you choose.
You want any model, including a local one.
You want it in any channel (Slack, Discord, Telegram, and more).

faq.a: No. SpaceXSI's pages offer no source code or self-hosted version; its open-source Grok Build is a different product.

faq.q: Which model does Grok Bot use?
faq.a: Grok Bot picks it per task, from SpaceXSI or a third-party provider, and does not show which. Pots uses the model you choose.

faq.q: Can Pots use my Grok subscription?
faq.a: Yes. `pots login` can sign in with a subscription you already pay for, Grok among them.
Yes. Pots is MIT-licensed; you bring the machine and the model.

faq.q: Is Pots affiliated with SpaceXSI or xAI?
faq.a: No. The other products as their makers described them in public, checked 2026-11-10; they may have changed since. Grok Bot, dots, Claude Duet, Claude Tag and Muse are products of SpaceXSI, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta. pi-durable-bot is not affiliated with any of them.
